title: 简单蒸馏（国内版）
author_source: project/Fume Hood & Cabinet Protocols/05_Simple Distillation（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 蒸馏：按沸点分离互溶液体
points.K4: 从烧瓶开始搭，接口要严密
points.K6: 夹牢烧瓶，冷凝管两端支撑
points.K7: 冷凝管怎样把蒸气变成液体
points.K12: 加液不过半，搅拌子与沸石
points.K13: 先慢速搅拌，再确认后加热
points.K14: 中等加热，沸腾过猛就降温
points.K16: 易燃溶剂：防护、远离火源
points.K19: 看曲线，适时更换接收瓶
points.S6: 检查玻璃仪器，扎牢水管

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，身后是一套蒸馏装置，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with a simple glass distillation setup behind it and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们来学简单蒸馏。

shots.scene: 烧瓶、温度计、冷凝管、接收瓶四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a round bottom flask, a thermometer, a glass condenser and a collecting cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 加热、汽化、冷凝、收集，一步步来。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一瓶有颜色的混合液，看着桌上一堆玻璃仪器发愁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a bottle of colored liquid mixture and frowns at a pile of glassware on the bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰要把混合液里的醇分出来。

shots.scene: 阿杰随手把烧瓶往加热板上一放，被小研叫住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student is about to put a flask straight on a hot plate; the female graduate student raises her hand to stop him.
shots.narration: 他想直接加热，被小研叫住了。

shots.scene: 小研指向实验室的通风柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points toward a fume hood at the side of the lab.
shots.narration: 蒸馏易燃溶剂，先换到通风柜里。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 装置搭对了，蒸馏才又准又安全。

shots.section_title: 蒸馏：按沸点分离互溶液体
shots.scene: 欣欣身边并排三个图标：漏斗、分液漏斗、蒸馏装置
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to three icons: a filter funnel, a separatory funnel and a distillation setup.
shots.narration: 过滤、萃取之后，再学一种分离方法。
overlay: 蒸馏：按沸点分离互溶液体

shots.section_title: 蒸馏：按沸点分离互溶液体
shots.scene: 蒸馏装置图标旁有温度计图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple distillation setup icon next to a thermometer icon, with a factory icon and a lab flask icon below. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸馏在实验室和工厂都很常用。

shots.section_title: 蒸馏：按沸点分离互溶液体
shots.scene: 两种液体倒在一起完全混匀，旁边是分层的液体被划开对比
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: two liquids mixing into one uniform layer, and two liquids forming separate layers in a funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 萃取分的是不相溶的两层液体。

shots.section_title: 蒸馏：按沸点分离互溶液体
shots.scene: 混匀的液体图标上方有两个不同高度的温度计
shots.prompt_en: A flask of uniform mixed liquid with two thermometer icons of different heights above it. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸馏分的是互溶液体，靠沸点不同。

shots.scene: 烧瓶在加热板上，温度计指针停在两条刻度线之间
shots.prompt_en: A flask on a hot plate with a big thermometer icon whose level sits between a low mark and a high mark. No people.
shots.narration: 加热到两个沸点之间的温度。

shots.scene: 烧瓶里一种小球飞成蒸气，另一种留在液体里
shots.prompt_en: Inside a flask, blue particles rise as vapor while red particles stay in the liquid below. No people.
shots.narration: 低沸点的变成蒸气，高沸点的留下。

shots.scene: 蒸气流过冷凝管，变成液滴落入接收瓶
shots.prompt_en: Vapor arrows travel through a glass condenser and turn into drops falling into a receiving flask. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸气冷凝成液体，流进接收瓶。

shots.scene: 两个温度计刻度靠得很近，被问号图标标出
shots.prompt_en: Two thermometer icons with marks very close together and a question mark icon beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 沸点差太小，另一种也会一起蒸出。

shots.scene: 小研站在实验台前，台上整齐摆着一排器材
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat and goggles stands at a bench with distillation parts laid out neatly.
shots.narration: 先把器材备齐。

shots.scene: 加热板、圆底烧瓶、蒸馏头三个器材特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hot plate stirrer, a round bottom flask and a three-way distillation adapter on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 热源、圆底烧瓶、蒸馏头。

shots.scene: 温度计套管、温度计、冷凝管、接引管特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a thermometer adapter, a thermometer, a long glass condenser and a bent receiving adapter. No people.
shots.narration: 温度计和套管、冷凝管、接引管。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶、量筒、烧瓶托、塑料接头夹特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of an Erlenmeyer flask, a graduated cylinder, a cork ring flask support and plastic joint clips. No people.
shots.narration: 接收瓶、烧瓶托和接头夹。

shots.scene: 两个铁架台和几只夹子
shots.prompt_en: Two ring stands with several clamps on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 还有铁架台和夹子。

shots.section_title: 从烧瓶开始搭，接口要严密
shots.scene: 小研把烧瓶托放在加热板上，再放入圆底烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a lab coat, goggles and gloves, sets a cork ring on a hot plate and places a round bottom flask on it.
shots.narration: 从圆底烧瓶开始：放在托上、加热板上。
overlay: 从烧瓶开始搭，接口要严密

shots.section_title: 从烧瓶开始搭，接口要严密
shots.scene: 小研在瓶口装上蒸馏头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fits a three-way distillation adapter onto the neck of the flask.
shots.narration: 瓶口装上带侧臂的蒸馏头。

shots.section_title: 从烧瓶开始搭，接口要严密
shots.scene: 小研从顶部装温度计套管和温度计
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student inserts a thermometer through an adapter on top of the three-way adapter.
shots.narration: 顶部装上温度计套管和温度计。

shots.section_title: 从烧瓶开始搭，接口要严密
shots.scene: 磨口接头特写，薄薄涂一层脂并旋转
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a ground glass joint with a thin layer of grease, being turned gently to seat it. No people.
shots.narration: 磨口可涂少量脂，旋转贴合，不漏气。

shots.scene: 蒸馏头剖面示意，温度计感温球略低于支管口
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of the distillation head: the thermometer bulb sits just below the side arm opening, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 感温球放在支管口稍下方。

shots.scene: 感温球太高、太低两个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two small icons of a thermometer bulb placed too high and too deep in the flask, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 太高太低，量到的都不是蒸气温度。

shots.section_title: 夹牢烧瓶，冷凝管两端支撑
shots.scene: 小研用夹子夹住烧瓶颈部
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student clamps the neck of the flask to a ring stand.
shots.narration: 在烧瓶颈部夹牢。
overlay: 夹牢烧瓶，冷凝管两端支撑

shots.section_title: 夹牢烧瓶，冷凝管两端支撑
shots.scene: 冷凝管从侧臂往下滑的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a condenser sliding down off the side arm, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 冷凝管斜着装，容易往下滑脱。

shots.section_title: 夹牢烧瓶，冷凝管两端支撑
shots.scene: 小研在另一个铁架台上夹住接引管，与冷凝管相连
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student clamps the receiving adapter on a second ring stand and joins it to the end of the condenser.
shots.narration: 另一端夹住接引管，两头都有支撑。

shots.section_title: 冷凝管怎样把蒸气变成液体
shots.scene: 冷凝管剖面动画：外套里冷水流动，内管蒸气变成液滴
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway animation of a condenser: cold water flows in the outer jacket while vapor in the inner tube turns into drops. No people.
shots.narration: 冷凝管外套通冷水。
overlay: 冷凝管怎样把蒸气变成液体

shots.section_title: 冷凝管怎样把蒸气变成液体
shots.scene: 内管玻璃壁上凝出水珠，顺管流下
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of droplets forming on the cold inner glass wall of the condenser and running down. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸气碰到冷玻璃壁，又变回液体。

shots.scene: 冷凝管示意：蓝箭头从下口进、上口出
shots.prompt_en: A condenser diagram with a blue arrow entering at the lower hose barb and leaving at the upper hose barb. No people.
shots.narration: 冷却水从下口进、上口出。

shots.scene: 小研把进水管接到水龙头，出水管引到水槽
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student connects the lower hose to a water tap and leads the upper hose into the sink.
shots.narration: 进水接龙头，出水引到水槽。

shots.scene: 上进下出的冷凝管图标里有气泡，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a condenser with water entering from the top and a big air pocket inside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 反过来接，外套灌不满，冷却变差。

shots.scene: 小研把量筒放在接引管出口下方
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places a graduated cylinder under the outlet of the receiving adapter.
shots.narration: 接引管出口下方放好接收器。

shots.scene: 量筒刻度特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the blank graduated cylinder markings under the adapter outlet. No people.
shots.narration: 用量筒接，可以随时读出体积。

shots.scene: 小研逐个检查接口，旁边浮现一串打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks each glass joint one by one; small green check marks appear beside them.
shots.narration: 装好后，每个接口逐一检查。

shots.scene: 小研在磨口处扣上塑料接头夹
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student snaps a plastic joint clip onto a ground glass joint.
shots.narration: 夹子要紧，接口用接头夹锁住。

shots.scene: 小研打开水龙头，水流平稳通过冷凝管
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens the tap; water flows smoothly through the condenser jacket.
shots.narration: 先通冷却水，确认水流顺畅。

shots.scene: 一瓶红色混合液，旁边是醇瓶和水滴图标
shots.prompt_en: A flask of red colored liquid next to a blank solvent bottle icon and a water drop icon. No people.
shots.narration: 示例是加了染料的醇和水各半。

shots.scene: 沸点较低的醇被标出，向上箭头
shots.prompt_en: The solvent bottle icon is highlighted with an upward arrow while the water drop icon stays put. No people.
shots.narration: 醇的沸点低，先被蒸出来。

shots.scene: 红色染料小点都留在水滴图标里，旁边一杯无色液体
shots.prompt_en: Red dye dots stay inside the water drop icon, next to a beaker of clear colorless liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 染料留在水里，馏出液是无色的。

shots.section_title: 加液不过半，搅拌子与沸石
shots.scene: 小研把红色溶液倒入圆底烧瓶，液面在一半以下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours red liquid into the round bottom flask, stopping below the halfway line.
shots.narration: 加液不超过烧瓶的一半。
overlay: 加液不过半，搅拌子与沸石

shots.section_title: 加液不过半，搅拌子与沸石
shots.scene: 装满的烧瓶液体溅进冷凝管的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an overfilled flask splashing liquid up into the condenser, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 太满了，液体会溅进冷凝管。

shots.section_title: 加液不过半，搅拌子与沸石
shots.scene: 搅拌子放入烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: A white magnetic stir bar drops into the liquid in the flask. No people.
shots.narration: 放入搅拌子，让受热均匀。

shots.section_title: 加液不过半，搅拌子与沸石
shots.scene: 几粒沸石落入烧瓶，液面平静
shots.prompt_en: A few small boiling chips drop into the cool liquid in the flask. No people.
shots.narration: 也可加沸石，让沸腾更平稳。

shots.section_title: 先慢速搅拌，再确认后加热
shots.scene: 小研慢慢转动搅拌旋钮，搅拌子缓缓转动
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slowly turns the stirring knob; the stir bar spins gently in the flask.
shots.narration: 先开搅拌，从慢速开始。
overlay: 先慢速搅拌，再确认后加热

shots.section_title: 先慢速搅拌，再确认后加热
shots.scene: 旋钮图标两端的过慢和过快被标出
shots.prompt_en: A dial icon with the very low end and the very high end marked in orange, and the middle range in green. No people.
shots.narration: 不同仪器档位不同，要试着调。

shots.section_title: 先慢速搅拌，再确认后加热
shots.scene: 小研再次检查接口和冷凝水，然后打开加热
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student double checks the joints and the running condenser water, then switches on the heater.
shots.narration: 再确认连接和冷凝水，才开加热。

shots.section_title: 中等加热，沸腾过猛就降温
shots.scene: 加热旋钮转到中间档位
shots.prompt_en: A heater dial icon turned to the middle setting with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 加热开到中等，受热才均匀。
overlay: 中等加热，沸腾过猛就降温

shots.section_title: 中等加热，沸腾过猛就降温
shots.scene: 旋钮开到最大、烧瓶液体剧烈翻腾的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a heater dial turned to maximum and a flask with violently splashing liquid, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 温度太高，液体会剧烈翻腾。

shots.section_title: 中等加热，沸腾过猛就降温
shots.scene: 小研把加热调低，再把热源移开
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns the heat down and then slides the heat source away from under the flask.
shots.narration: 沸腾过猛，就调低或撤走热源。

shots.section_title: 中等加热，沸腾过猛就降温
shots.scene: 时钟图标旁，烧瓶慢慢冷却
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon next to a flask cooling down with a falling temperature arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 等完全冷却了，再重新开始。

shots.section_title: 中等加热，沸腾过猛就降温
shots.scene: 两个靠得很近的温度计同时冒泡
shots.prompt_en: Two thermometer icons with close marks, both with bubbles rising, and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 沸点差不大，过热两种会一起沸腾。

shots.scene: 烧瓶里液体平稳沸腾，气泡均匀
shots.prompt_en: The liquid in the flask boils evenly with small steady bubbles while the stir bar spins. No people.
shots.narration: 设置得当，液体会平稳沸腾。

shots.scene: 蒸馏头内壁出现小液滴
shots.prompt_en: Small droplets condense on the inner wall of the distillation head around the thermometer. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸气升到蒸馏头，开始冷凝。

shots.scene: 液滴从接引管口滴进量筒
shots.prompt_en: Clear drops fall from the adapter outlet into the graduated cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 进入冷凝管变成液体，滴进量筒。

shots.section_title: 易燃溶剂：防护、远离火源
shots.scene: 欣欣举着易燃液体警示标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a flammable liquid warning sign.
shots.narration: 收集到的醇高度易燃。
overlay: 易燃溶剂：防护、远离火源

shots.section_title: 易燃溶剂：防护、远离火源
shots.scene: 眼睛和手的图标旁有警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an eye and a hand, each with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 溅到眼睛、皮肤上，伤害不小。

shots.section_title: 易燃溶剂：防护、远离火源
shots.scene: 小研穿实验服、戴护目镜和手套站在装置旁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a lab coat, safety goggles and nitrile gloves while watching the distillation setup.
shots.narration: 实验服、护目镜、手套都要穿戴好。

shots.section_title: 易燃溶剂：防护、远离火源
shots.scene: 火焰和火花图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an open flame and electric sparks, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 附近不能有明火和火花。

shots.scene: 小研看着量筒刻度，在空白表格上记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads the graduated cylinder and writes in a blank data table.
shots.narration: 蒸馏时还可以顺便采集数据。

shots.scene: 量筒刻度每升一格，旁边的温度计闪一下
shots.prompt_en: Each time the liquid in the cylinder rises one mark, the thermometer icon beside it blinks. No people.
shots.narration: 每接一毫升，记下总体积和温度。

shots.scene: 量筒液面到达预先标好的线
shots.prompt_en: The liquid level in the cylinder reaches a pre-marked line with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 收到与原来加入的醇量相当为止。

shots.scene: 温度计液柱随量筒液面一起升高
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon rises alongside the liquid level in the graduated cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 馏出越多，温度越高。

shots.scene: 烧瓶里蓝色小球越来越少
shots.prompt_en: Inside the flask, blue particles become fewer and fewer while red particles remain. No people.
shots.narration: 醇被不断蒸走，混合物组成在变。

shots.scene: 接引管口不再滴液，温度计停住
shots.prompt_en: The adapter outlet stops dripping and the thermometer icon stops rising, with a pause icon. No people.
shots.narration: 醇蒸完了，冷凝停止，温度不再升。

shots.section_title: 看曲线，适时更换接收瓶
shots.scene: 空白坐标图上画出先上升后变平的折线
shots.prompt_en: A blank graph with axes draws a line that rises steeply and then levels off. No people.
shots.narration: 曲线先上升，再慢慢变平。
overlay: 看曲线，适时更换接收瓶

shots.section_title: 看曲线，适时更换接收瓶
shots.scene: 平台段被圈出，旁边是目标物沸点的虚线
shots.prompt_en: The flat part of the line is circled, with a dashed line marking the target boiling point just below it. No people.
shots.narration: 收集到略高于目标物沸点为止。

shots.section_title: 看曲线，适时更换接收瓶
shots.scene: 小研把接收器换成另一只
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student swaps the receiving cylinder for a fresh empty flask.
shots.narration: 温度明显再升，就换接收瓶。

shots.section_title: 看曲线，适时更换接收瓶
shots.scene: 高沸点杂质的小球被挡在新瓶外
shots.prompt_en: Icons of red impurity particles kept out of the first collected flask by a separating line. No people.
shots.narration: 这样就不会混进高沸点的杂质。

shots.scene: 小研举起一杯无色馏出液，旁边是剩下的红色残液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up a beaker of clear distillate next to the flask of remaining red liquid.
shots.narration: 蒸馏完成，得到无色的醇。

shots.scene: 无色液体和红色液体两个图标对比
shots.prompt_en: Two beaker icons side by side: one clear and one red. No people.
shots.narration: 一清一红，分离效果一目了然。

shots.scene: 两个沸点刻度几乎重合的温度计
shots.prompt_en: Two thermometer icons with almost the same mark. No people.
shots.narration: 要是两种液体沸点很接近呢？

shots.scene: 烧瓶和冷凝管之间多了一根竖直分馏柱
shots.prompt_en: A distillation setup diagram with a tall vertical column inserted between the flask and the condenser. No people.
shots.narration: 在冷凝管前加一根分馏柱。

shots.scene: 分馏柱剖面里一层层玻璃珠
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of the column showing layers of small glass beads with vapor passing through. No people.
shots.narration: 柱里的填料，让分离更彻底。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在通风柜旁，柜内有蒸馏装置
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a fume hood with a distillation setup inside.
shots.narration: 加热有机溶剂，要在通风柜里做。

shots.scene: 通风柜示意，柜门拉到规定高度线
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood icon with its sash lowered to a marked line and airflow arrows going inward. No people.
shots.narration: 柜门拉到规定高度，以本校规定为准。

shots.scene: 柜门全开、人头探进柜内的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fully raised fume hood sash with a head leaning inside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要把头伸进柜内。

shots.scene: 本生灯火焰图标被打叉，旁边是电加热套和水浴
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a gas burner flame crossed out with a red X, next to an electric heating mantle and a water bath with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸易燃溶剂，不能用明火加热。

shots.scene: 小研把烧瓶放进电加热套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sets the round bottom flask into an electric heating mantle inside the fume hood.
shots.narration: 选电加热套、水浴等热源。

shots.scene: 插座远离溶剂瓶的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a power socket placed away from solvent bottles, with a distance arrow between them. No people.
shots.narration: 电器插头远离溶剂，防止火花。

shots.scene: 接引管支管口有气流箭头通向外面
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the small side opening of the receiving adapter with an airflow arrow leading out. No people.
shots.narration: 常压蒸馏，体系一定要通大气。

shots.scene: 所有出口都被塞住的装置图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a distillation setup with every opening stoppered shut and a pressure warning, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 全部塞死再加热，装置可能炸裂。

shots.scene: 小研检查接引管支管没有被堵住
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks that the small side opening of the receiving adapter is open.
shots.narration: 接口严密，但出口必须留着。

shots.scene: 冷液体中加沸石打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of boiling chips added to a cool flask with a green check and a snowflake-cool mark. No people.
shots.narration: 沸石要在加热之前加。

shots.scene: 向翻滚的热液中投沸石的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of boiling chips dropped into a hot boiling flask, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 千万别往热液里补加沸石。

shots.scene: 小研关掉加热，等烧瓶冷下来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches off the heater and waits for the flask to cool, with a clock icon beside her.
shots.narration: 忘加了，先停热、冷却，再补加。

shots.scene: 烧瓶底还剩少量液体，打勾；烧干的烧瓶打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a flask with a little liquid left at the bottom with a green check, and a dry flask crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 烧瓶里留少量液体，不要蒸干。

shots.scene: 蒸干的烧瓶出现裂纹的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dry overheated flask with a crack and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸干会过热，烧瓶可能破裂。

shots.scene: 顺序图标：关热源、等冷却、关水、拆装置
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in order with arrows: heater off, cooling clock, tap closed, glassware taken apart. No people.
shots.narration: 先停热撤热源，冷了再关水、再拆。

shots.scene: 小研戴隔热手套等装置冷却
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears heat resistant gloves and waits beside the cooling setup without touching the flask.
shots.narration: 热玻璃和加热板很烫，别急着摸。

shots.section_title: 检查玻璃仪器，扎牢水管
shots.scene: 小研对着光检查烧瓶有无裂纹
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a round bottom flask up to the light and checks it for cracks.
shots.narration: 用前检查玻璃仪器有没有裂纹。
overlay: 检查玻璃仪器，扎牢水管

shots.section_title: 检查玻璃仪器，扎牢水管
shots.scene: 带星形裂纹的烧瓶被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a flask with a small star-shaped crack, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有裂纹、缺口的不能加热。

shots.section_title: 检查玻璃仪器，扎牢水管
shots.scene: 水管接口用卡箍扎牢
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the cooling water hose secured on the condenser hose barb with a clamp. No people.
shots.narration: 冷却水管要扎牢，水流不要太大。

shots.section_title: 检查玻璃仪器，扎牢水管
shots.scene: 水管脱落、水淋到加热板上的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hose popping off and water spraying onto a hot plate, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 脱管漏水，可能淹到加热设备。

shots.scene: 小研把馏出液和残液分别倒入两只废液桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours the distillate and the residue into two separate labeled waste containers with blank labels.
shots.narration: 馏出液和残液都要分类收集。

shots.scene: 向水槽倒溶剂的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of solvent being poured into a sink drain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有机溶剂不能倒进下水道。

shots.scene: 王老师检查废液桶上的空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the blank labels on the waste containers with the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 按本校规定标注，交给学校统一处置。

shots.scene: 装置旁冒出小火苗，小研关掉电源
shots.prompt_en: A small flame appears near the setup; the female graduate student switches off the power at the socket.
shots.narration: 溶剂着火，先断电、撤走溶剂。

shots.scene: 灭火器和灭火毯图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fire extinguisher and a fire blanket. No people.
shots.narration: 小火用灭火器或灭火毯扑灭。

shots.scene: 阿杰在水槽用流水冲手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student cools his hand under running water at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 被烫伤，立即用流动冷水冲。

shots.scene: 洗眼器标志和洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign above a lab eyewash station with water flowing. No people.
shots.narration: 溅进眼睛，马上到洗眼器冲洗。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有火焰和红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a fire icon and a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 火势大拨119，有人受伤拨120。

shots.scene: 小研向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man in the lab office.
shots.narration: 事后报告实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现通风柜、电加热套、护目镜图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a fume hood, a heating mantle and safety goggles.
shots.narration: 通风柜里做，不用明火，穿好防护。

shots.scene: 温度计位置、两端夹持、下进上出三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a thermometer bulb by the side arm, a clamped condenser and water arrows in low out high. No people.
shots.narration: 温度计位置对，两端夹牢，下进上出。

shots.scene: 加液不过半、沸石、通大气三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a half full flask, boiling chips in a cool flask and an open adapter outlet. No people.
shots.narration: 不过半，先加沸石，体系通大气。

shots.scene: 中等加热、记录表、换接收瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a middle heater dial, a blank data table and two receiving flasks. No people.
shots.narration: 中等加热，边收边记，适时换瓶。

shots.scene: 不蒸干、停止顺序、废液桶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a flask with a little liquid left, an order of steps arrow and a waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 不蒸干，先停热后停水，废液分类。

shots.scene: 欣欣在通风柜前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in front of a tidy fume hood with a cooled distillation setup.
shots.narration: 蒸得清清楚楚，做得安安全全，再见！
